# gigahost_server_size (Data Source)

Selects exactly one deployable server size from the live catalog. Give any combination of `type`, `size`, `cores`, `memory_gb`, `storage_gb`; if more than one size matches, set `cheapest = true` to pick the lowest hourly rate, otherwise the lookup errors listing the candidates. Feed the result into `gigahost_server` via `type` and `slug`. List sizes with `gigahost deploy sizes`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Pick a size by hardware criteria instead of hardcoding a slug.
data "gigahost_server_size" "small" {
  memory_gb = 4
  cheapest  = true
}

resource "gigahost_server" "web" {
  type = data.gigahost_server_size.small.type
  size = data.gigahost_server_size.small.slug
  os   = "debian-12"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cheapest` (Boolean) Pick the lowest hourly rate when several sizes match.
- `cores` (Number) CPU core count to match. Filled with the resolved cores.
- `memory_gb` (Number) Memory in GB to match. Filled with the resolved memory.
- `platform` (String) Platform to search: `cloud` (default) or `metal`. Filled with the resolved platform.
- `size` (String) Size slug or unique fragment of one, e.g. `2c-4gb-40gb` or `4gb`.
- `storage_gb` (Number) Total storage in GB to match. Filled with the resolved storage.
- `type` (String) Server type slug, e.g. `value` or `performance` (list with `gigahost deploy types`). Filled with the resolved type.

### Read-Only

- `bandwidth_gb` (Number) Included bandwidth in GB.
- `category` (String) Product category: `vm`, `dedicated`, or `auction`.
- `currency` (String) ISO currency code prices are quoted in.
- `name` (String) Commercial product name, e.g. `KVM Value VPS 4GB`.
- `rate_hourly` (Number) Hourly price in the account's currency.
- `rate_monthly` (Number) Monthly price in the account's currency.
- `regions` (List of String) Region slugs the size is offered in.
- `slug` (String) Canonical size slug for `gigahost_server.size`.
